image_description: A vintage-style aneroid barometer with a dark, polished wooden casing of irregular, shield-like shape. The central dial is brass-colored with black numerical markings and a pointer hand. To the left of the dial, there is a vertical thermometer attached to the casing. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.

The connection between the vertical thermometer on the left and the main wooden casing looks slightly fused and lacks a distinct mechanical mounting bracket, appearing somewhat melted into the wood.
The edge of the wooden casing shows slight softness and lack of sharp definition against the background, suggesting minor edge bleeding or smoothing artifacts.
